spine.deviation_notes: Multi-variant element identity (chaos/lightning/pierce) collapsed to the dominant PIERCE build -> element-neutral. Source player of the chaos (shadow) WoP Vampirris variant loses their element slot. The devotion-proc payloads (Flame Torrent etc.) are the kit's real damage flavor but map to nothing — names only, no fetched behavior — so the mapping understates proc-driven output. 'Elemental agony' brand has no tokenable status.

skills.delivery_notes: At-target 'pain aura' brand stamped on the pack, ~1.5-screen coverage radius, ticking elemental agony over the branded zone; cast-and-forget. Element-neutral in the dominant pierce variant (full ele->pierce conversion via Nadaan's Reach; pierce = armor-piercing physical, §1 physical rule).
Persistent ground field placed under the player (~1.5-screen), providing damage mitigation and proc-trigger platform. Defensive anchor + devotion-proc host.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Stamp Word of Pain on packs and hold the Inquisitor Seal; the brand ticks agony over a huge footprint while the seal mitigates and hosts procs; Blade Arc fills in the pierce variant

resource_economy.cadence_shape: cooldown-based rotation; Word of Pain is cast-and-forget, Inquisitor Seal is a persistent field

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: elem_raw corpus tag = 'fire' is ERRATUM (hot-fact) — fetched text shows chaos/lightning/pierce variants + 'full ele to pierce conversion'; the DOMINANT published guide ([1.1.9.0] Blade Arc + WoP pierce) is the pierce build -> element-neutral (§1 physical rule; pierce is armor-piercing physical, no engine family) + ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL door (conversion IS the build's point). §A devotion-proc riders: Shifting Sands, Hand of Ultos, Flame Torrent are NAMED for 'proc synergy' but behaviors UNFETCHED -> contribute NOTHING to mapping_json beyond this note (§0.4 name != payload). trigger_grammar apply-only/linked-cast reflects the seal's proc-host role generically. NO ailment token: 'pain'/'agony' are flavor, no burn/bleed/etc STATUS named (§0.1). Chaos variant (Vampirris, shadow) + lightning variant noted, out of dominant loop.
